title_en: The Girl Lay Down and Fell Asleep
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional (Aegean Macedonian feel). 'Луди, млади' I read as 'young fellows'; the line 'низ прстен да го поминат' is my reading and uncertain.

lines.en: A girl lay down, fell asleep, oh dear soul,
in that little garden,
in that little garden,
under that olive tree.

lines.cyr: Поддувнал Југот од море, леле џанам,
lines.lat: Podduvnal Jugot od more, lele džanam,
lines.en: The south wind blew from the sea, oh dear soul,
it broke an olive branch,
it broke an olive branch,
it struck the girl on the face.

lines.cyr: - Оф леле, Боже, до бога, леле џанам,
lines.lat: - Of lele, Bože, do boga, lele džanam,
lines.en: - Oh dear, God, dear God, oh dear soul,
how nicely I had been sleeping,
how nicely I had been sleeping,
what a good dream I dreamed.

lines.cyr: Три луди, млади, над мене, леле џанам,
lines.lat: Tri ludi, mladi, nad mene, lele džanam,
lines.en: Three young fellows stood over me, oh dear soul,
one was exchanging a ring with me,
another was picking flowers for me,
the third was kissing my face.

lines.cyr: Тоа што прстен менваше, леле џанам,
lines.lat: Toa što prsten menvaše, lele džanam,
lines.en: The one who exchanged the ring, oh dear soul,
may they pass him through a ring (my reading).
The one who picked flowers,
may he wither like a flower.

lines.cyr: Тоа што лице љубеше, леле џанам,
lines.lat: Toa što lice ljubeše, lele džanam,
lines.en: The one who kissed my face, oh dear soul,
the one who kissed my face,

lines.cyr: дај ми го, Боже, пред мене,
lines.lat: daj mi go, Bože, pred mene,
lines.en: give him to me, God, before me,
that I may live my life with him.
